info.title: Homebrewery API
info.description: The Homebrewery WYSIWYG back end (docs/wysiwyg-plan.md §8). Same origin as the SPA: cookie sign-in, and writes need an Origin header matching the site. Errors are problem+json.

get.summary: The signed-in account, or 204 when anonymous.

put.summary: Set the public handle used in /user/{handle}.
put.description: A handle is 3 to 32 characters: lower-case letters a-z, digits, '-' and '_'. Case-insensitive; stored in lower case. 409 when taken.

get.summary: The full brew for the editor (authors only), including the version to save against.
The read-only brew. Counts a view unless the caller is an author.
get.description: A locked brew answers 423 with the lock's share message as `detail` and its code as `code`.

post.summary: Create a brew (new or imported); the caller becomes its owner.
post.description: Optional `Idempotency-Key` header (1-128 visible ASCII characters, e.g. a UUID; surrounding quotes are stripped): within 24 hours, the same user sending the same key with the same request again gets 201 with the brew the first request created (as it is now) instead of a second brew; the same key with a different request is 422. A malformed key is 400 with errors['Idempotency-Key'].

put.summary: Save the whole brew against baseVersion (409 with the server version when stale).
put.description: Only doc, style, snippets and the metadata fields are written. An invited author becomes an author on their first save. Only the owner may change meta.authors.

delete.summary: Leave the brew as an author; the brew is deleted when no owner or author remains.

post.summary: Copy a brew by share id into a new, unpublished brew owned by the caller.
Ask the moderators to review this brew's lock (authors only). Asking again keeps the first request time.
post.description: 409 when the brew is not locked. The admin review queue lists the brew until an admin unlocks it or dismisses the request.

get.summary: Search published brews (title, description and text), sorted and paged.
get.description: `q` uses web search syntax with the `simple` text search configuration (no stemming, any language). `sort`: relevance (default with `q`), updated (default without), created, views, title. `dir`: asc or desc (default asc for title, desc otherwise). `pageSize` is clamped to 1-60 (default 20) and `page` to 1-10000. An unknown `sort` or `dir`, or a `q` over 256 characters, is a 400 validation problem.

get.summary: A user's brews: published ones for everyone; all of them, with edit ids, for the user.
Static themes, published user themes, and the caller's own user themes.
A theme's inheritance chain, root first: stylesheets (URLs or raw user-theme CSS) and snippet sources.
get.description: `theme` is a static theme key (e.g. `5ePHB`) or a user theme's share id. 404 when it is neither; 422 (problem+json with `chain`) for a cycle, a chain longer than 8 themes, or a base theme that is missing or not tagged `meta:theme`; 423 when a theme brew in the chain is locked.

get.summary: The Homebrewery markdown of a brew on homebrewery.naturalcrit.com, by its share id.
get.description: Fetches `https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/download/{shareId}` and returns it as text/plain (the brew text with its ```metadata and ```css blocks). `shareId` must be 10-14 letters, digits, `_` or `-` (400 otherwise). 404 when the Homebrewery has no such brew, 413 when the text is over 2 MB, 502 when the Homebrewery fails, answers an error (then `upstreamStatus` holds its status; a locked brew answers its lock code), redirects or times out. Rate limited per user (429).

get.summary: Notifications to show now (startsAt <= now < stopsAt), oldest start first.
Site totals: brews, published brews, users, locked brews and pending lock reviews.
Accounts whose handle or email contains q (case-insensitive), or whose id is q; at most 50, exact matches first.
Every brew of an account as the account itself sees them: unpublished, locked and invited ones included, with edit ids and roles.
A brew (without its document) by internal id, share id or edit id.

put.summary: Lock a brew: its share page shows shareMessage (423) and its editor shows editMessage. Replaces an existing lock.

delete.summary: Remove a brew's lock (a no-op when it is not locked).
Dismiss the authors' review request and keep the lock (409 when the brew is not locked).

get.summary: Every locked brew, most recently locked first.
Locked brews whose authors asked for a review, oldest request first.
Every notification (past, current and future), newest start first.

post.summary: Create a notification (409 when the dismiss key is taken).

roles.description: Role names, e.g. `["Admin"]`; empty for regular users.

authors.description: All authors in display order, owner first (invited users included).

AdminBrewInfo.description: A brew for the admin pages (`GET /api/admin/brews/{id}`, lock changes). Never contains the document.

code.description: Reason code (100-999), shown to authors and readers.

editMessage.description: Shown to the authors in the editor.

shareMessage.description: Shown instead of the brew on its share page.

reviewRequested.description: When an author asked for a review, or null.

AdminLockInfo.description: A moderation lock as stored (both messages).

pendingReviews.description: Locked brews whose authors asked for a review.

brewCount.description: Brews the user is an author of, in any role.

lockoutEnd.description: Set while Identity's lockout (failed sign-ins) blocks the account.

role.description: `owner`, `author`, or `invited` (can edit; becomes `author` on their first save).

version.description: The version to send back as `baseVersion` on the next save.

docSchemaVersion.description: Schema version of Doc; the client migrates older documents on load.

sourceMarkdown.description: The original Homebrewery markdown when the brew was imported, or null.

authors.description: All authors in display order, owner first.

oneOf.description: The moderation lock, or null. Saving still works while locked.

BrewForEdit.description: Everything the editor needs (`GET /api/brews/edit/{editId}`, and the result of create and clone).

editId.description: Only for the brew's own authors (so the share page can link to the editor); otherwise null.

authors.description: Author handles in display order (invited users excluded).

views.description: View count, including this view when it counted.

message.description: The lock's edit message for the authors.

BrewLockInfo.description: A moderation lock as the editor shows it.

title.description: At most 100 characters. When saved blank, the first heading of the document is used.

tags.description: Free-form tags (e.g. `type:adventure`, `meta:theme`); at most 50 of 100 characters.

theme.description:
A static theme key (`5ePHB`, `5eDMG`, `Blank`, `Journal`, `UnearthedArcana`)
    or the share id of a user theme.

published.description: Listed in the vault and on the author's page.

thumbnailUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL used for link previews, or null.

authors.description:
The full author list as handles, in display order. Only the owner may change it on save
    (403 otherwise, unless the list is unchanged): new handles become `invited`, missing ones are removed, the
    owner always stays first. Unknown handles are a validation error. Null leaves the list unchanged.

BrewMetaInput.description:
Metadata in a create or save request. Every field is optional: null (or missing) keeps the current value on
save and uses the default on create. To clear a thumbnail send an empty string.

editId.description: Only in the caller's own list (`GET /api/users/{handle}/brews` as that user); otherwise null.

authors.description: Handles of the owner and authors in display order (invited users excluded).

theme.description: A static theme key or a user theme's share id.

published.description: Always true in the vault and in other people's lists.

lastViewedAt.description: When the share page last counted a view, or null.

oneOf.description: The caller's role; only in the caller's own list, otherwise null.

locked.description:
Whether a moderation lock blocks the share page. Locked brews appear only in their authors'
    own lists.

BrewSummary.description: A brew in a list (the vault, a user's page). Never contains the document.

doc.description: The document; omitted = one empty page.

oneOf.description: Metadata; `meta.authors` invites other users (the caller is the owner).

sourceMarkdown.description: For imports: the original Homebrewery markdown (kept for reference).

docSchemaVersion.description: The document's schema version; must be the server's current one when given.

CreateBrewRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/brews` (a new brew, or an import). May be sent gzip-compressed.

brewDeleted.description:
True when the caller was the last author and the brew is gone; false when only the
    caller was removed from the author list.

authors.description: Handles of the owner and authors in display order.

LockedBrewInfo.description: A locked brew in `GET /api/admin/locks` and the review queue.

code.description: Reason code, 100-999 (upstream's lock tool defaults to 455).

editMessage.description: Required; shown to the authors in the editor. At most 1000 characters.

shareMessage.description: Required; shown instead of the brew on its share page. At most 1000 characters.

LockRequest.description: Body of `PUT /api/admin/brews/{shareId}/lock`. Replaces any existing lock (and clears its review request).

dismissKey.description: Unique key; the client remembers it when the user dismisses the notification.
Required, unique, at most 100 characters (409 when another notification uses it).

RawJson.description:
JSON text written into a response as is: stored `jsonb` (a brew's doc and snippets) reaches the client
without being parsed and re-serialized (plan §8.2). In the OpenAPI document it is an unconstrained value.

baseVersion.description: The version the client last loaded or saved. A different server version gives 409.

snippets.description: User snippets (JSON array); null clears them.

oneOf.description: Metadata changes; null keeps all metadata.

docSchemaVersion.description: The document's schema version; must be the server's current one when given.

SaveBrewRequest.description: Body of `PUT /api/brews/{editId}` (plan §8.4). May be sent gzip-compressed.

version.description: The new version; send it as the next `baseVersion`.

title.description: The stored title (the first heading when the title was blank).

authors.description: The author list after the save.

SaveConflict.description: 409 body: the brew changed since `baseVersion` (another tab, device or author saved).

theme.description: The theme that was asked for.

name.description: Display name of that theme (a static theme's name or a user theme's title).

author.description: Owner handle of that theme when it is a user theme; otherwise null.

styles.description:
Stylesheets, root first: the scoped URL of each static theme, then each user theme's CSS
    (raw: the client scopes it to the canvas, like user CSS). User themes without CSS add nothing.

snippets.description:
Snippet sources, root first: a static theme's snippet group id (`V3_5ePHB`), or a user
    theme's snippets as `{ name, snippets }`. User themes without snippets add nothing.

ThemeBundle.description:
Response of `GET /api/themes/{theme}/bundle` (plan §8.7): the theme's inheritance chain, root first. Apply
`styles` in order, then the brew's own CSS.

key.description: Theme id, e.g. `5ePHB`; the value of a brew's `meta.theme`. Same as the folder name.

baseTheme.description: Key of the theme whose CSS loads before this one, or null for a root theme.

baseSnippets.description:
Key of the theme whose snippets upstream merged under this theme's, or null.
    Informational: upstream no longer uses it and the bundle ignores it.

style.description: URL of the compiled, unscoped stylesheet (export).

scopedStyle.description: URL of the stylesheet scoped under `.hb-canvas` (editor canvas).

preview.description: URL of the theme picker preview image, or null.

texture.description: URL of the theme picker texture image, or null.

hasSnippets.description: Whether the theme has its own snippets (snippet group `V3_{key}`).

ThemeCatalogEntry.description:
A static (built-in) theme: one entry of `/themes/themes.json`, which the web build writes
(`web/vite/generateAssetsPlugin.ts`, `ThemeCatalogEntry`). `GET /api/themes` returns these entries
as they are.

user.description:
User themes (brews tagged `meta:theme`): the caller's own first (published or not), then
    published ones, each group by name. At most 500.

ThemeList.description: Response of `GET /api/themes`: every theme the caller can pick.

ThemeSnippetRef.description: A static theme's snippet group id (e.g. "V3_5ePHB"), or a user theme's name and snippets.

ThemeStyle.description: One stylesheet of a theme chain: `{ kind: 'url', href }` or `{ kind: 'css', css, shareId }`.

css.description: The theme brew's CSS as stored.

shareId.description: The user theme it came from.

ThemeStyleThemeStyleUrl.description: A static theme's stylesheet (already scoped under `.hb-canvas`).

own.description:
True when the caller is this user: the list then includes unpublished and locked brews and brews
    the user is invited to, with edit ids and roles.

items.description: At most 1000 brews. In the user's own list, brews they are only invited to come after the others.

total.description: All brews the caller may see in this list (may exceed the items returned).

UserBrewList.description: A user's brews (`GET /api/users/{handle}/brews`), most recently updated first.

shareId.description: The theme id to store in a brew's `meta.theme`.

author.description: Handle of the theme brew's owner, or null.

baseTheme.description:
The theme this one builds on (the theme brew's own `meta.theme`): a static key or
    another user theme's share id.

thumbnailUrl.description: The theme brew's thumbnail, or null.

published.description: Whether the theme brew is published (listed for everyone).

mine.description: Whether the caller is an owner or author of the theme brew.

UserThemeInfo.description: A user theme: a brew tagged `meta:theme`, used as a theme by its share id.
